The measurement shows that learning by day would be too slow on this PC. The inhabitants learn new things in the computing night.
Not measured yet: the measurement run shows whether your PC can also learn by day.

Switched on, the inhabitants talk new things over with the AI during the day as well - it then uses computing power while you play. Switched off, everything happens in the computing night and the inhabitants learn more slowly.
The AI service is not running right now. It starts with a world; without it the inhabitants live by simple rules.
The AI service reports a state this version of the game does not know yet. A diagnostics report will help.

How the inhabitants live: they do familiar things out of habit. When they meet something new – an unknown thing, a stranger, your voice – they ask the language AI, at once or in the computing night. At night the AI also sorts their memories and ideas with them. What they learn shapes their habits.
